data.name: Banyu Carbon
data.description: Banyu Carbon is a Seattle-based ocean CDR startup spun out of the University of Washington in 2022 by chemical oceanographers Alex Gagnon and Julian Sachs. The company is developing a sunlight-driven photoacid process to remove CO2 from seawater, and has raised approximately $8.5M from investors including Grantham Foundation, Propeller, United Airlines Ventures, Carbon Removal Partners and ReGen Ventures. It was selected by Frontier for a pre-purchase, joined Ocean Visions' Launchpad, and received a DOE voucher.
